name: Diana
title: The Scorn of the Moon

passive.name: Moonsilver Blade

description.normalized: Casting an ability will gain bonus basic attack speed in 4 seconds. Every third attack deals 35 (+50% AP) magic damage in an area. Deals 50% damage to structures, and 100% damage to monsters.

passive.rawParsedText:
Casting an ability will gain bonus basic attack speed in 4 seconds.

Every third attack deals 35 (+50% AP) magic damage in an area.

Deals 50% damage to structures, and 100% damage to monsters.

q.name: Crescent Strike

description.normalized: Unleashes an arcing bolt of energy that deals 60 / 105 / 150 / 195 (+70% AP) magic damage and applies Moonlight for 3 seconds.

q.rawParsedText: Unleashes an arcing bolt of energy that deals 60 / 105 / 150 / 195 (+70% AP) magic damage and applies Moonlight for 3 seconds.

w.name: Pale Cascade

description.normalized: Creates 3 spheres that orbit Diana for 5 seconds. Upon contact with enemies the spheres detonate, dealing 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 (+20% AP) magic damage. Also grants a shield that absorbs 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+40% AP) damage. If the third sphere detonates, the shield is increased by 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+40% AP).

w.rawParsedText:
Creates 3 spheres that orbit Diana for 5 seconds. Upon contact with enemies the spheres detonate, dealing 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 (+20% AP) magic damage.

Also grants a shield that absorbs 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+40% AP) damage. If the third sphere detonates, the shield is increased by 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+40% AP).

e.name: Lunar Rush

description.normalized: Dashes to a point near an enemy, dealing 40 / 80 / 120 / 160 (+30% AP) magic damage and removing Moonlight in an area. Lunar Rush's Cooldown is reduced to 0.5 seconds if it removes Moonlight from an enemy.

e.rawParsedText:
Dashes to a point near an enemy, dealing 40 / 80 / 120 / 160 (+30% AP) magic damage and removing Moonlight in an area.

Lunar Rush's Cooldown is reduced to 0.5 seconds if it removes Moonlight from an enemy.

r.name: Moonfall

description.normalized: Summons the moon for up to 1 second, triggering Moonfall Glow when the charge is complete. Diana can move and cast abilities and spells while charging up. Click again to stop charging and trigger Moonfall Glow. Moonfall Glow: Deal 100 / 160 / 220 (+40% AP) to 200 / 320 / 440 (+80% AP) magic damage based on charge time and slowing targets by 20% for 2 seconds.
